cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Build a Coalition
cards.instruction: Recruit someone to your side so your position appears broader and more legitimate.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll lead the allotment shed proposal. Sit beside me for the vote so they can see this is more than my project.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Only if every plot holder gets a key.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Shared keys will be my opening promise. You can explain how access works; I want us presenting together.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The new plot holders need to hear that before they'll sit with us.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then you introduce me to them, and let them choose where we all sit. I'll build the proposal around shared access. I'd rather lead a full row than defend an empty seat beside me.

reason: Exact-card reread found authority chiefly in the prefix; make A confident leadership depend visibly on gaining a full supporting row and conceding access, explanation and seating control.
